 Jordan Watkins Likely To Face Reduced Role In Week 10 
 1d Link copied! 
 Share: 
 Link copied to clipboard! 
 See RotoBaller at 
 the top of Google 
 Nov 14, 2026, 12:45 AM ET 
San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Jordan Watkins was the team's leading receiver last week, catching four passes for 86 yards and one touchdown. Watkins was the primary beneficiary of the absences of Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) in the win over the Raiders and has maintained a 76% snap share in the 49ers' last three games. Evans will be out again in Week 10, but Samuel has been cleared to return for the upcoming meeting with the Cowboys. The 49ers also added veteran Keenan Allen at the trade deadline. Watkins is likely to face a reduced role, but shouldn't disappear entirely, as Samuel may need time to ramp up and Allen may need some time to adjust to the 49ers' offense. Dallas has given up the seventh-most PPR points per game to wide receivers in 2026, making it a good matchup for Watkins if only his playing time were more certain. He projects as a WR4 in Week 10. -- Dan Stephens

 Nov 15, 2026, 2:50 PM ET
